import json,sys,time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace')
from wire import v,envelope,datagram,trace,stream
from h import run

# 131072 frame starts: 65536 padding + 65536 ping  (payload ~131072 bytes)
body=b'\x00'*65536+b'\x01'*65536
t0=time.time()
r=run({"traces":[trace([{'keys':['A']},datagram(envelope('A',0,body),auth=[0])])]})
print('padding+ping %.1fs'%(time.time()-t0), r['traces'][0]['packets'][0]['status'], r['traces'][0]['datagrams'][0]['bytes'])

# many stream frames, adjacent chunks
n=130000
body=b''.join(stream(0,i*64,b'x'*64) for i in range(n//1))[:8*1024*1024]
body=body[:8000000]
t0=time.time()
r=run({"traces":[trace([{'keys':['A']},datagram(envelope('A',0,body),auth=[0])])]})
print('streams %.1fs'%(time.time()-t0), r['traces'][0]['packets'][0]['status'], r['traces'][0]['streams'][0]['unique'], r['traces'][0]['streams'][0]['ranges'][:3])

# duplicate overlap stress: same 4MB range repeatedly
frame=stream(0,0,b'x'*1000)
body=frame*8000
t0=time.time()
r=run({"traces":[trace([{'keys':['A']},datagram(envelope('A',0,body),auth=[0])])]})
print('dup overlap %.1fs'%(time.time()-t0), r['traces'][0]['packets'][0]['status'], r['traces'][0]['streams'][0]['unique'])

# 8192 events
evs=[{'keys':['A']}]+[datagram(envelope('A',i,b'\x01'),auth=[0]) for i in range(8191)]
t0=time.time()
r=run({"traces":[trace(evs)]})
print('events %.1fs'%(time.time()-t0), len(r['traces'][0]['packets']), r['traces'][0]['received'])

# 32768 header attempts: 4 envelopes per datagram x 8192 datagrams
dgs=[datagram(envelope('I',i*4,b'\x01')+envelope('I',i*4+1,b'\x01')+envelope('I',i*4+2,b'\x01')+envelope('I',i*4+3,b'\x01'),auth=[0,0,0,0]) for i in range(8192)]
t0=time.time()
r=run({"traces":[trace(dgs)]})
print('attempts %.1fs'%(time.time()-t0), len(r['traces'][0]['packets']), r['traces'][0]['received']['I'])
PYEOF
python3 perf3.py
